verdict: Strong organic reach this period, but two issues need immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile listings drove 4,054 organic actions — 386 calls and 1,609 direction requests across Canton and Fishers — making organic search your primary volume driver this period. However, GBP actions dropped to zero on October 29–30, a confirmed signal of visibility loss that is being investigated now. On the paid side, Google Ads launched four days ago and recorded 33 conversions from 160 clicks on $93.21 in spend, but conversion tracking is being repaired, as those conversions are not currently mapping to actual leads. Next period you can expect a corrected lead count from Google Ads and a resolution on the GBP visibility drop.
